summary: St. Joe NF hike-in lookout in Shoshone County: an L-4 cab built 1935 and destroyed 1972; no source describes what, if anything, remains today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a tower, with a patrol point 1.5 miles west atop Champion Point
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1972. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

access.note: On St. Joe National Forest land; Idaho Fire Lookouts classes it as hike-in; no closure or permit described

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as hike-in.

events.note: L-4 cab on a tower, 1935 in both sources

notes_for_editor: Build year 1935 agrees across two sources, but Idaho Fire Lookouts lists a known staff member for 1934, a year before the build date; neither source explains the gap, so the 1934 staffing is left as a dated claim. The page gives the book's author as Bert Russell, while a search snippet gives Burt Russell; check the spelling. A Forest Lookouts Shoshone County entry for Wonderful Peak has no history line, so it is not cited. Nothing in the sources describes the site today.
